title: Sachin Bansal's fintech Navi raises first outside capital with $100M Prosus investment | TechCrunch
summary: Bansal founded Navi in 2018 after leaving Flipkart following its sale to Walmart. In the financial year ended March 2026, Navi reported that it generated ₹30.91 billion (about $323.33 million), while its net loss grew to ₹4.66 billion (around $48.74 million).
